note: Subprocess APIs that invoke a shell: metacharacter injection works. Languages without a shell entry are in sink.exec.noshell. Rev 1 merged both into one row and marked only Go/Rust 'no shell' — Java and .NET were wrongly implied shell-capable.

verified.what: shell_exec runs via /bin/sh; $(...) command substitution expands

sinks.name: Process.Start
gates: legacy UseShellExecute=true only; false is the modern default

verified.source: Runtime.exec(String) tokenizes without a shell — see sink.exec.noshell

hazards: shell presence is the whole game for metachar payloads — check the family before assuming ';' or '&&' works
escapeshellarg/shlex.quote defeat metachars; move to argument injection (noshell family) if quoting is present

php backticks are NOT in the grep pattern set: MySQL identifier quoting (`users`) makes backtick patterns false-positive at scale on SQL-heavy PHP (a backtick-to-backtick span containing $vars still matches). Find literal backtick sinks by eye or AST, not grep.
non_transfers: java/dotnet/go/rust default paths — no shell; a metachar payload there is a no-op
